channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Keaton Wagler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Keaton Wagler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Keaton Wagler
item.description:
Lawrence Frank on Keaton Wagler's skillset:

“He's got incredible body balance. And I think these are lessons you learn when scouting, when athleticism is a very, very broad term. And what we've learned is functional athleticism is different than athleticism. And Keaton very much embodies that.”

Lawrence Frank on Keaton Wagler, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Keaton Wagler
item.description:
Frank:

“We really think Keaton's best basketball is way ahead of him. He'll contribute now, but I think he obviously has to get stronger. He's going to continue to put a ton of work in. There's a lot of growth to be made.”

Lawrence Frank on Keaton Wagler, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brad Underwood on Keaton Wagler
item.description:
Illinois coach Brad Underwood said.

“Because to me, it’s the innocence and the parenting 101 lesson. They were very dialed in to Keaton’s happiness and his ability just to play the game he loved and be a great teammate. You couldn’t write a better manuscript.”

Brad Underwood on Keaton Wagler, Jun 22, 2026. Source: New York Times.
